metadata.runner: Static package inspection, separated reviewer contexts, and analytical adjudication
known_limitations: Comparable live host runs and protected holdout not run.
Shared model family and frozen source constrain reviewer independence.
The originating workflow is design provenance, not a run of this version.

acceptance_criteria.authority: Exact identities, bounded writes and data audiences
acceptance_criteria.preservation: Independent placement, version and access results
acceptance_criteria.coverage: Qualified parity and readback of affected references
acceptance_criteria.publication: Draftable catalog source with synthetic examples and no operational maturity claim
